title: Conversations contract errors
description: The closed list of errors the contract defines. A records tool error is a tools/call result with isError: true whose first text content is JSON {code, error}, code from `records`. An app tool error is a tools/call result with isError: true whose first text content is JSON {error}, the message beginning with the `prefix` of one entry in `app`; the app carries no code on the wire in 1.0. `error` text is diagnostic beyond what is stated here. A request refused before any tool runs (no or invalid credential, a connection with no scope) is the transport's answer and outside this list.

records.meaning: The arguments do not match the tool's input schema. Nothing was written.
No records tool by that name.
The call reached the server with no workspace or no owner in its scope. Nothing was read or written.

append_events named a conversation absent from the caller's scope: another owner's, another workspace's and a missing one answer alike. Nothing was written. Reads answer null or an empty page instead.
create named an id already stored in the caller's scope. Nothing was written.
create in a workspace the implementation holds nothing for (deleted, or never created). Nothing was written.
The stored conversation cannot be read.
Anything else. The error text is diagnostic only.

app.meaning: get, update or export named a conversation outside the caller's scope or absent; the id named follows the prefix.
id was omitted, or "current", on a call made outside a chat.
tools/call reached the app with no workspace or no authenticated identity in its scope.
The arguments do not match the tool's input schema; the tool name follows the prefix, quoted. Nothing was written.
No app tool by that name.
